workarounds.note: the H1 breakBefore is restated (parity 'odd') because a headings object drops it
headings have no letterSpacing, so the tracked capitals of level 3 are drawn by an advanced design (design text takes letterSpacing)
the profile is an opener image, which reserves no height: minHeight reaches past the profile's foot, so the text starts on the first grid line 6 mm or more under it
col() writes each colour's hex beside its paletteId, because design slots (the pills, the rules, the running heads) never read the palette
level 1 keeps the default numberFormat 'arabic' and levels 2 and 3 name 'lower-alpha' and 'lower-roman'; the CSS word 'decimal' would print 'undefined'

a no-break space is not trusted to hold a number to its unit (it breaks in paragraphs with inline formatting; a plain justified paragraph kept it in every re-test), so sentences are reworded until '5 per cent', '30 cm' and '15 to 20 cm' each stay on one line (and on one page) in each edition
locale is the exact bundled code ('en-us' | 'es'); a region-tagged code would hyphenate as American English
every frontmatter value is quoted (a bare value can print empty in {title})

keepColonWithList strands a lead-in line ending in ':' when the list's first item runs to two lines and only one line is left (the item cannot split, but the rule checks for one line): 1.2's first item is kept to one line in each edition so its colon line and list stay together

bodyText.maxRuntTracking is 0 (gotcha runt-tracking-unpainted): in 1.4.1 a runt fix can set a paragraph one line shorter with negative tracking (a block letterSpacing of up to -10 per mille), which the layout measures but the canvas renderer never paints, so its justified word spaces print crushed (round 1 had three such paragraphs, among them 1.3 on the hero, at about 4 px of ink per gap beside 7-8 px lines); every paragraph of both editions is also copy-fitted to the 0.85-1.4 spacing band, so no runt fix fires at all (tightenRunts: false gives the same layout)
a heading drops its inline marks, so the seventh level is the heading style level7 (italic, lighter, grey) on a level-6 heading instead of *marks* in the title (gotcha heading-marks-dropped)
